item.title: Bunin Documentary: The Silent Genius Pianist’s Remarkable Revival
item.description: The Bunin documentary seeks to encapsulate the life of the Russian-born pianist, Stanislav Bunin. item.description: In an emotional display of gratitude, Ski Cross star Satoshi Furuno honored his late grandfather at the Winter Olympics. item.title: Art Connects Noto: Monthly Visit Program by Tokyo Art Group
item.description: Art connects Noto, a beautiful yet challenged region in Japan, as a Tokyo-based art group, SIDE CORE, initiates a monthly visiting program to the earthquake-affected areas of the Noto Peninsula. This program began in October 2023, following the devastating Noto Peninsula earthquake on January 1, 2024, which struck the already dwindling population of the area. The influx of individuals who cherish Noto, including those who relocated from urban centers, plays a crucial role in the area’s recovery.

item.title: Mongil: STAR DIVE Unveils Cat Mascot in Purrfect Celebration of Cat Day
item.description: On Cat Day, *Mongil: STAR DIVE* takes center stage with delightful and adorable cat-themed content. Network Marble has kicked off a series of posts on its official X account, showcasing the game’s mascot character “Nyanko.” The posts, designed to celebrate this day, began at 2:22 AM (local time) and continue hourly, drawing attention to this captivating character. *Mongil: STAR DIVE* is an action RPG available for free, playable on PC (via Netmarble Launcher/Epic Games Store), iOS, and Android.

item.title: Farewell to Oshima Bookstore: Heartfelt Messages Abound as Closure Approaches
item.description: In a profound moment for the community, Oshima Bookstore, located in Ishikawa, Uruma City, Okinawa, is set to close its doors forever on February 28. item.title: Mock Car Racing Ignites Excitement at Pacifico Yokohama
item.description: Mock car racing is a fantastic way to nurture interest in manufacturing and automobiles among families.
